featured_reviews.review_text:
My friend purchased a used from Deals On Wheels. At the time of sale, the dealer assured us that the car was in good condition and did not disclose any major issues.

However, after using the vehicle, we discovered that the car appears to have previous flood damage and accidental history, which was never properly informed before purchase. Within just around 1 year, the vehicle started giving multiple serious problems, and the estimated repair cost is now around ₹5–6 lakhs after already paying nearly ₹20 lakhs for the car.

Very disappointing experience. Buyers should do a complete independent inspection, service history check, accidental/flood verification, and scan report before purchasing any used vehicle from here.

Posting this review so that other customers can stay careful and make informed decisions before buying.
